user.title: Caméra XiongMai
user.description: XiongMai / XMEye / NetSurveillance IP camera, connected through its own protocol (DVRIP). For every firmware setting, also install the “Caméra XiongMai” app.

data_description.name: Device name in Home Assistant, e.g. “Porch”.

data_description.port: 34567 by default: the CMS software port, not web port 80.
data_description.password: Empty if the camera has no password.
